اجتبين (form VIII)
# اِجْتَبَيْنَ (ijtabayna) /id͡ʒ.ta.baj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# اُجْتُبِينَ (ujtubīna) /ud͡ʒ.tu.biː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# اِجْتَبِينَ (ijtabīna) /id͡ʒ.ta.biː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
